caption:
Most shops don't lose leads to bad marketing.

They lose them to a text thread, a sticky note, and a voicemail nobody logged. By the time someone checks, the lead's gone cold or called a competitor.

Black Arrow OS is a free pocket CRM built for exactly this problem. Every lead lands in one place. You see who you called, who you texted, and who's still waiting on a reply, all from your phone.

Speed decides the sale. Industry data shows most service businesses take hours to respond to a new lead, while contacting one within five minutes can double your odds of closing it. You can't move fast on a lead you can't find.

No signup. No card. Just a clear view of every lead you've got right now.
